notes.title: Easy 2.0
notes.content:
[b]Easy is a sophisticated 2D platform that offers 22 interesting and elaborate levels filled with many traps. Complete them as fast as you can and beat your past time records!

▎You now have the opportunity to set impressive high scores at the most difficult levels and share them on social media with the hashtag "#XG_Easy". The best players will be written by the developer and they will be tagged on his social networks. The game's graphics just got even better, and optimization! Large-scale work has been carried out on the design of the levels: almost all the old levels have been updated, and new ones have been added.

[list]
[*]
[/list]Now all levels are available at once. If you find a level difficult, you can return to it later and complete the next one - all uncompleted levels are marked with an "X".

 Forward to new records!

Geampley -
[previewyoutube=o05OnVFyjwc;full][/previewyoutube]
Easy in Steam[/b]
